title: Universal Life Insurance Declared Rate Schedule: Fixed-Account Interest and Indexed Segments
content:
The fixed account of every Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance tier earns the current declared rate, never less than the guaranteed minimum rate; the three Indexed UL tiers also accept allocations to the indexed account, credited by one-year point-to-point S&P 500 segments on the terms below.

## Declared rates

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Indexed account available | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Guaranteed minimum interest rate on the fixed account (annual) | 2% | 2% | 2% | 1% | 1% | 1% |
| Current fixed account rate (annual, credited monthly) | 3.5% | 3.75% | 4.25% | 3.25% | 3.25% | 3.25% |

As decimals: guaranteed minimum 0.02 or 0.01; current fixed account rate 0.035, 0.0375, 0.0425, 0.0325, 0.0325, 0.0325.

## Indexed segment terms

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Index cap rate per segment | 0% | 0% | 0% | 9.5% | 10.5% | 11.25% |
| Participation rate | 0% | 0% | 0% | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Floor rate per segment | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Segment term | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Day of the month a new segment starts | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

The cap and participation figures of the three non-indexed tiers are zero because those tiers accept no indexed allocation. As decimals the caps are 0.0950, 0.1050 and 0.1125, and the participation rate is 1.00.

## Questions answered

**On which tiers may premium go to the indexed account?** Only the Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect, Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth and Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier.

**What does the segment credit come to? (hypothetical)** On the Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth, an S&P 500 change of 14% over the segment, times participation of 100%, is capped at 10.5%; a change of 6% is credited at 6%; a fall of 4% is credited at the floor of 0%.
